It also replaces an exhaustive2^b syndrome search by b signed-capacity splits, while retaining the paid explicit-family count cost. These are complete useful interfaces, not a uniform polynomial-n encoder/decoder when t grows. The full adversarial mixed-edit code/decoding question remains open. P2 58FB sharpens the count to M<=(10n/t)^(2t), establishing a concrete existential C=7, and gives the standard shortened-BCH uniform substitution-only subcase t<=sqrt(n). Pointwise whole-coset isolation gives a conditional decoding simplification; both full mixed-edit computational primitives remain UNCONSTRUCTED. Explicit enumeration is superpolynomial for t~log n, a method-specific failure only.
